title: Bridging Academia and Industry: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Attributed Graph Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2602.08519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Attributed Graph Clustering (AGC) is a fundamental unsupervised task that integrates structural topology and node attributes to uncover latent patterns in graph-structured data. Despite its significance in industrial applications such as fraud detection and user segmentation, a significant chasm persists between academic research and real-world deployment. Current evaluation protocols suffer from the small-scale, high-homophily citation datasets, non-scalable full-batch training paradigms, and a reliance on supervised metrics that fail to reflect performance in label-scarce environments. To bridge these gaps, we present PyAGC, a comprehensive, production-ready benchmark and library designed to stress-test AGC methods across diverse scales and structural properties. translated_title: 连接学术界与工业界：面向属性图聚类的综合基准
translated_abstract: 属性图聚类是一种基础的无监督任务，它将结构拓扑与节点属性相结合，以挖掘图结构数据中的潜在模式。尽管属性图聚类在欺诈检测、用户细分等工业应用中具有重要意义，但学术研究与实际工业部署之间仍存在显著的鸿沟。当前的评估方案存在诸多局限：数据集局限于规模小、同质性高的引文网络数据集，采用难以扩展的全批次训练范式，并且依赖有监督指标，无法真实反映标签稀缺环境下的性能。为弥合这些差距，我们提出了PyAGC——一个全面、可用于生产环境的基准测试库，旨在对属性图聚类方法在不同规模和结构特性下进行压力测试。我们将现有方法统一到一个模块化的“编码-聚类-优化”框架中，并首次为广泛的（方法）提供了内存高效的小批次实现。
tldr: 该论文提出了PyAGC——首个面向属性图聚类、可直接用于生产环境的综合基准库，通过统一的“编码-聚类-优化”模块化框架和内存高效的小批次实现，弥合了学术研究与真实工业部署之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PyAGC, a comprehensive production-ready benchmark library for Attributed Graph Clustering, which bridges the gap between academic research and real-world deployment through a unified modular Encode-Cluster-Optimize framework and memory-efficient mini-batch implementations.
